The return value is used to indicate errors detected by the

RTE Implementa-
tion Plug-In

(SRS_Rte_00094, SRS_Rte_00091)

[SWS_Rte_70067]
⌈
RTE_E_HARD_TRANSFORMER_ERROR
 The return value of
one transformer in the transformer chain represented a hard transformer error.
⌋
(SRS_Rte_00094, SRS_Rte_00091)
•
[SWS_Rte_70068]
⌈
RTE_E_SOFT_TRANSFORMER_ERROR
 The return value of
at least one transformer in the transformer chain was a soft error and no hard
error occurred in the transformer chain.
⌋
(SRS_Rte_00094, SRS_Rte_00091)
•
[SWS_Rte_70069]
⌈
RTE_E_COM_STOPPED
 the
RTE Implementation
Plug-In
could not perform the operation because the communication service
is currently not available.
⌋
(SRS_Rte_00094, SRS_Rte_00091)

[SWS_Rte_70118]
⌈
RTE_E_COM_BUSY
 the
RTE Implementation
Plug-In
could not perform the operation because the transmission is re-
jected due to a currently ongoing transmission. The transmission is not
executed.
⌋
(SRS_Rte_00094, SRS_Rte_00091)
